SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN state = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as chargeOrderAmount, COUNT(*) as charge_order_cnt FROM tb_charge_order
AND create_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}/1000)
AND create_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime}/1000)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN state = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as withdrawOrderAmount, COUNT(*) as withdraw_order_cnt FROM tb_withdraw_order
AND create_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}/1000)
AND create_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime}/1000)

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 END) as online_privilege_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_investment_record
AND order_date >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}/1000)
AND order_date <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime}/1000)
) as privilege_cnt FROM tb_project

SELECT COUNT(*) as zc_cnt FROM tb_user
AND create_date >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}/1000)
AND create_date <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime}/1000)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(investment_amount), 0) AS xs_amount FROM tb_investment_record
AND order_date >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}/1000)
AND order_date <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime}/1000)
